## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] User-facing feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests or maintenance
- [ ] Security or privacy improvement

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Manually checked relevant UI/API behavior

If a check was not run, explain why:

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No secrets, private prompts, or personal data included
- [ ] API error behavior and provider setup remain clear
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed
- [ ] Keyboard access and responsive layout considered for UI changes

## Screenshots or reproduction steps

Add screenshots or steps when they help reviewers verify the change.
